g.text: Voice pipeline — one turn between the learner and May
target: end-to-end < 1s (R-TE-1) · barge-in ≤ 300ms (R-SE-8) · D-035 · D-036 · D-037 · D-045
holds the WebSocket · owns Gemini connection
STT + LLM + TTS in one model
⑤ May's audio · transcript (< 1s from ①)
⑥ session end — encode PCM→Opus → upload
Latency budget: VAD 100–200ms + browser→backend 30–60ms + backend→Gemini 5–20ms + Gemini think 400–600ms + first audio back 40–80ms ≈ 575–960ms
Barge-in (R-SE-8): learner speaks → client VAD stops playback locally (~10ms) AND cancel signal goes upstream → May stops within 300ms.
Heartbeat (D-036): ping every 20s. Two missed pongs → reconnect (1s/2s/4s, cap 10s). Server re-attaches to Gemini with a state summary — never resends audio (R-TE-5).
